tool_input.command:
while true; do
  S=$(curl -sf -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.secrets 2>/dev/null | grep BUILDKITE_API_TOKEN | cut -d= -f2)" "https://api.buildkite.com/v2/organizations/acme/pipelines/acme-gateway/builds/18424" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('state',''))" 2>/dev/null || true)
  case "$S" in
    passed|failed|canceled|blocked) echo "build 18424: $S"; exit 0;;
    "" ) ;;
  esac
  sleep 45
done
